deadline.value: January 1 deadline for Fall admission with full consideration for all financial aid
deadline.quote: The deadline for Fall admission with full consideration for all possible financial aid is January 1.

gre_general.value: GRE scores are not required, but applicants may report scores if desired.
gre_general.quote: We do not require GRE scores for applicants to our Graduate Program, but you may report your scores if you would like them to be considered.

gre_subject.value: GRE Subject scores are not required, but applicants may report scores if desired.
gre_subject.quote: We do not require GRE scores for applicants to our Graduate Program, but you may report your scores if you would like them to be considered.

supervisor.value: Pre-application supervisor agreement is not required.

funding.value: All PhD students receive 5 years of full financial support.
funding.quote: All our PhD students receive 5 years of full financial support.

entry_route.value: Direct admission from four-year bachelor's degree.
entry_route.quote: A four-year bachelor’s degree, a three-year bachelor’s plus a master’s degree, or a three-year bachelor’s plus completion of first year of the master’s program from a recognized institution by the Association of Indian University (AIU) or All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).
